index.summary: Independent review requests changes: five reproduced functional issues remain.

record.summary: Reviewed the current uncommitted implementation against iteration requirements. Existing build and tests pass, but the implementation does not yet satisfy AC03, AC04, AC05, AC06, and AC07.
record.context: Review baseline: HEAD 2ae424be7d135d8f94bd8744be6762ceb181633d plus current working-tree changes. Used the locally built Debug CLI for isolated temporary-workspace reproductions. F1 (P1): TaskBlockers resolves dependencies only inside the selected tasks.xml and requires done, while TaskContextQuery rejects valid cross-iteration dependencies. Reproduction: a validated workspace with a completed upstream task in another iteration yields start-work from task next, an unknown dependency blocker from task blockers, and RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND from task context. Reuse the shared dependency resolver and its terminal-state semantics. F2 (P1): --ignored=matching returns an ignored directory entry, but WorkspaceVcsStatus matches only exact file paths and defaults missing entries to clean. Ignoring /.dogdouspec/ yields vcs_checkpoint passed and clean/checkpointed despite all authoritative files being ignored. Expand ignored directories or inspect tracking/ignore state per file. F3 (P1): TaskContextResult.ToHumanString omits ScopeElement entirely; the same task includes src/upstream in XML context but loses the scope in human context. Render all mandatory scope include/exclude rules in both formats. F4 (P2): TaskContextQuery builds permitted actions from task status alone. A pending task with an in-progress prerequisite advertises Start task, but task start fails with TASK_TRANSITION_CONFLICT. Derive permissions from the shared gates. F5 (P1): TaskResume with no finding or summary resolves every active finding and writes only an automatic Resumed task message. A credential blocker requiring owner-provided proof was closed by a bare resume command without caller-supplied resolution evidence. Require explicit resolution confirmation and evidence before closing findings.
record.outcome: Changes requested. Preserve terminal task history; create authorized follow-up repair tasks or use the governed change workflow, then independently re-review the reproductions. This informational handoff does not approve product acceptance, rewrite existing review submissions, or reopen terminal tasks. No product code was changed and no Git commit or push was performed.
